curl --request POST \
  --url https://api.hellotext.com/v1/attribution/actions \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $HELLOTEXT_API_TOKEN" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{
    "name": "appointment.booked",
    "title": "Cita reservada",
